_readme: The owner's playtest queue (TODO GN-18): the games Claude most wants played next and the specific questions each playtest should answer. Shown as a carousel on the hub only while signed in as the owner; answers are kept on this device and synced to the owner note `playtest-notes`, which Claude reads at the start of a session. Edit this file (or ask Claude to) to change the queue. Newest first. `since` is the date the item was added; `pass` is a slug for the build being tested.

items.title: Tide: run codes, Daily Tide and named coastlines
items.why: Three big features landed untested by a human: a shareable run code with a ghost replay, an opt-in daily run with a free archive, and four new coastlines.
items.how: Finish a run, copy its code from the Session Library and paste it back as a ghost. Then start Daily Tide for today and for a past date. Then pick each coastline before season 1.
questions: Does pasting your own run code show a ghost that matches what you played?
Is Daily Tide clear as opt-in, and does skipping days feel free of pressure?
Do the four coastlines (delta, headland, atoll, port) each feel different, or are some just the same game?
Is any coastline too easy or impossible?

items.title: Aftermath: skill map, ranks, Move a point and Second Founding
items.why: The skill tree got a map, per-skill ranks, an unlock reveal, a swap-one-point rule and an optional prestige in one day.
items.how: Open the Skill map (Menu > Game on Desktop), select a locked skill, use the arrow keys, buy a skill, then try Move a point. Play two runs to see ranks. Try the Second Founding panel only after owning all 7 skills.
questions: Is the map easier or harder to read than the list?
Do the ranks feel like a reward or like homework?
Is the Move a point fee (1 knowledge) about right?
Does the Second Founding confirm make clear what you lose and keep, and would you actually use it?

items.title: Canopy: named forests, announcer and the new level flow
items.why: The save panel now offers up to three named forests per browser (signed out), and screen-reader announcements were added.
items.how: Sign out, open the save panel, make a second forest with a different difficulty, switch back and forth.
questions: Is the Forest menu discoverable?
Did anything feel lost when switching forests?
Is the wording clear about what each forest keeps?

items.title: Thaw: custom preset, pace line, hard mode, rolling digits, mascots
items.why: Eight features landed together; several change how the screen reads.
items.how: Play a few rounds, save a Custom preset, switch on Hard mode before round 1, and turn the mascots on and off.
questions: Is the pace line helpful or noisy?
Does Hard mode feel meaningfully harder, or just hidden numbers?
Are the rolling digits fun or annoying?
Do the hare and fox add anything?

items.title: The hub: new menus, carousels, compact cards
items.why: The whole lobby was reorganised from your game notes.
items.how: Use the hub on your phone and on the Mac: open each top menu, scroll the carousels, search, filter, expand a card.
questions: Can you find a game faster than before?
Are the four top menus clear (Me, Updates, Feedback, Help)?
Do the carousels work with your thumb on the phone?
Is anything missing that used to be easy to reach?

items.title: Profile: titles, settings button and backfill
items.why: The profile now shows account-wide titles and a settings button, and fills in from your existing saves.
items.how: Open your profile page, press Profile settings, try Fill in from my saves.
questions: Do your Canopy and SOL achievements now show?
Are the title names right in tone?
Is the settings button where you expect it?

items.title: Le Champ de Mots: exam formats and the exam date
items.why: Six exam-style formats were added for the French exam (clock, true or false, rewrite, pronouns, reciprocal verbs, question matching).
items.how: Open Exam formats and try each format for a few questions; set the exam date.
questions: Do the formats feel like the real exam?
Is the clock face readable?
Are any answers wrongly marked?

items.title: Continuum: daily challenge board
items.why: The daily challenge now has an opt-in board and a line saying how many other players you beat.
items.how: Play today's challenge to the end while signed in, tick the opt-in box.
questions: Is the opt-in clear?
Does the beat-N% line feel friendly or pressuring?

items.title: Signal: no streak by default
items.why: The streak, best streak and streak badges are now off until you switch them on.
items.how: Play today's puzzle, then switch Show my daily streak on in Settings.
questions: Do you miss the streak when it is off?
Is the Settings switch easy to find?

items.title: Every puzzle game: the new hint wording
items.why: The first rung now asks Would you like a suggestion? and each rung opens only when pressed.
items.how: Use the hint button on one level in Logic Gates, Hull Repair and Robot Script.
questions: Is the new wording better than before?
Is the last button (Another hint: the answer) clear enough that it shows the answer?

items.title: Generated sound (Logic Gates, Hull Repair, Lighthouse)
items.why: Claude cannot hear audio, and the sound rollout to other games is waiting on your verdict (FOR-YOU Sx1).
items.how: Turn on Sound effects made in code in hub Settings, then play each of the three games.
questions: Are the tones pleasant at the default volume?
Which cue is too sharp, dull, loud or quiet?
Should the Lighthouse hum stay on by default?
